name: suggest-engine
description: Editor-agnostic autocomplete suggestion engine with optional user word learning.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --entry-names=suggest-engine.esm --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && esbuild src/global.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/suggest-engine.js
